supersource.comment: ssrc id 0 = SuperSource 1. me 1 = M/E 2 (zero-indexed). ssInput = ATEM input number of the SuperSource. displayBox = zero-indexed box that carries the main display feed (box 4).

osc.comment: Add feedback targets as {"host": "<companion-ip>", "port": 9001} to push /status/... OSC to Companion.

transition.comment: mixRateFrames: if set, the engine pins the M/E mix rate (frames) for background fades; null = inherit the switcher. keyFadeMs: speed of pure border-key (USK) fades. videoFps: frame rate used to convert times into mix-rate frames.

companion.comment: Companion's built-in OSC API port (default 12321). Custom variables <prefix>active_look, <prefix>transitioning, <prefix>going_to, <prefix>coming_from are pushed there - create them in Companion.

propresenter.comment: ProPresenter Mac (Preferences > Network). Empty ip = built-in demo timer for designing renderer pages.
